index.docTitle: NoUpload — tools that never upload your file
index.description: PDF and image tools. Your file is never uploaded to a server; everything runs in your browser.
index.sub: PDF and image tools. Everything runs inside your browser — your file never leaves your computer, never reaches a server, and no one else can see it.
index.proof: Easy to verify: load the page, then turn off your internet. The tools keep working.
index.dgTitle: The file is processed inside your device and never reaches a server
index.dgNote: the file never touches the network
index.c1Title: The file goes to a server, gets processed there, comes back
index.c2Title: The file is processed on your device and never touches the network
index.why1: Your file travels to their machine, gets processed there and is sent back. Then they promise to delete it “within a few hours.” For a contract, a payslip or an ID scan, you have to take that on trust.
index.why2: There is no promise to trust. There is no server. Everything happens in your own browser and the file never touches the network — you can verify this yourself by turning off your internet.
index.foot: No server · no account · no tracking

foto.docTitle: Image Shrinker — get a photo under a size limit
foto.description: Resize a photo to the pixel size you need and push it under a file size limit. Your photo is never uploaded; everything runs in your browser.
foto.title: Image Shrinker
foto.sub: Resizes a photo to the pixel size you need and pushes it under a file size limit. For application forms that say "150 KB at most".
foto.privacy: Your file is never uploaded — everything runs in your browser.
foto.drop2: or click to choose · JPG, PNG, WebP
foto.hint: The aspect ratio is kept — the photo is scaled to fit inside these dimensions and is never cropped. If you don't know the size the institution wants, check the requirements on its application page.
